answer_1.quote: The integration of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances these models ... such as automating Wikipedia article generation.

answer_2.quote: We report reference-free metrics along two dimensions: informativeness and verifiability. We report article length, entity count, numerical data count, Citation Recall, Citation Precision, Citation Rate, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L, and LLM-based scores (Interest, Organization, Focus).

answer_3.quote: We employ Prometheus-2, a 7B-parameter evaluator LLM, to assess the generated articles based on three metrics: Interest Score, Organization Score, and Focus Score. For citation recall evaluation, we use gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18.
